mechanism: Eslicarbazepine may induce CYP3A4 metabolism and alter gastric motility, potentially reducing liraglutide efficacy, while liraglutide's delayed gastric emptying may affect eslicarbazepine absorption.
action: Monitor glycemic control and eslicarbazepine levels; consider dose adjustments if efficacy decreases; separate dosing times if possible to minimize gastric motility effects.
